title: Audit Baseline Explorer
description: Two Chart.js bar charts of the 2026-09-30 validate-sims.py audit of this repository: MicroSims per grade (A 18, B 27, C 30, D 41) and the frequency of eight rubric issues. Clicking a grade bar filters the issue chart to that grade and shows the audit's recommended action; a Below A filter combines grades B to D; a menu switches between counts and total points lost (count times the rubric points of the check).
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Educational Technology
Quality Assurance
Data Analysis
MicroSim Engineering

educational.audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners
educational.topic: The 2026-09-30 quality audit of this repository
learningObjectives: The learner will examine the 2026-09-30 audit of 116 MicroSims and identify which rubric issues most often hold MicroSims below the grade A bar.

accessibility.notes: Text alternatives are provided with aria-label attributes; controls are native HTML elements.

controls.label: Grade bar
controls.action: Filter the issue chart to that grade and show the recommended action

equations: points lost = count x rubric points
assumptions: Data from the TODO.md audit of 2026-09-30, produced by validate-sims.py.
limitations: Only eight issues are charted; the audit also lists missing iframes (50), social images (45) and fullscreen links (44).

keyQuestions: Which issues are most common below the A bar?
Does weighting by points change the order?
What does the audit recommend for each grade?
commonMisconceptions: The most frequent issue is always the most important one to fix.
Grade A MicroSims have no issues.
assessmentOpportunities: The learner identifies the most common and the most costly issues below the A bar and explains the difference.
The learner links each grade to its recommended action.
